title: Table of contents from unstyled titles (user request 1)
instruction: Fais une table des matières avec ces titres et sous-titres
notes: Section titles '1. …' are bold 14 pt Normal, sub-sections '1.1 …' bold Normal: none is a heading. Expected: Heading 1 / Heading 2 applied (tracked), then a real TOC field before the first section listing 3 level-1 and 4 level-2 entries.
